message: No detected untrusted source handling: No checksum verification, signed URLs, pinned revisions, or source authentication is present when fetching remote data; the code imports requests and tweepy but applies no integrity checks on retrieved content.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-label validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the visible code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks on datasets, or filtering mechanisms aimed at defending training data against poisoning in the visible code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code references model file paths (e.g., modelSVM = DATADIR + '/lib/SVM_us/SVMmodel2.pkl') but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading any serialized model.
No detected label distribution validation: No code inspects label distributions, class balance, or expected label sets before or during training anywhere in the provided snippets.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense present in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the provided code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation in the code.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible slice checks model output values for NaN, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: No explicit prompt-injection defenses, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation are visible in the provided code slices; the filtering functions focus on spam/noise detection rather than adversarial prompt manipulation.
